candidate_space: WO2018173768-inspired PPG/4,4-MDI constrained grid (PUR_SIM_V1, synthetic; 58 blends x 16 NCO:OH points = 928 candidates)

uncertainty.rationale: The stored PUR_SIM_V1 viscosity intervals are log10(eta) +/- r. The ratio eta80/eta120 propagates both viscosity uncertainties, giving a frozen conservative ratio interval of log10(ratio) +/- 2r. The explicit source interval columns reproduce these multipliers to numerical precision.

layers.L0_property: argmin nominal property_score over all 928 candidates; no feasibility constraints
layers.L1_constrained: argmin nominal property_score over candidates passing point-response preferred/broad windows, NCO:OH, MDI fraction and chemistry-domain gates; uncertainty is intentionally not used at L1
layers.L2_robust: among L1 candidates whose full uncertainty intervals remain inside the broad functional windows, minimize the worst-case value of the same frozen log-space property objective

robustness.definition: robust_score = sum_k w_k * (abs(log10(y_k/c_k)) + q_k*r)^2, with q_eta80=q_eta120=1 and q_ratio=2; this is the exact worst case of the nominal objective over the frozen rectangular log-space interval
robustness.rationale: Preferred windows define the optimization target, not a certification envelope. Requiring the entire uncertainty interval to remain inside the preferred windows yields zero feasible candidates in the frozen 928-space. Robust admissibility therefore uses the literature-derived broad functional windows, while the same preferred-center objective is evaluated at the interval worst case. No new uncertainty weight is introduced; the nominal objective weights are inherited unchanged.

backward.manifold: mdi_parts = k_blend * nco_oh (exact on the frozen grid)

local_trends.nco_axis: increasing NCO:OH along the same blend
local_trends.composition_axis: increasing parts of the higher-MDI-demand component within the same two-component family at fixed NCO:OH

expected_from_docs.note: Pre-freeze expectations are retained only as an audit target. The freeze script reports disagreements and never edits data to match them.
